instruction: Describe the steps to change subtitle font size and style in VLC Media Player so that subtitles are easier to read.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. The original task asked about preventing VLC from auto-closing after video ends, which cannot be programmatically verified. This variation asks about changing subtitle font settings in VLC, which is similarly infeasible to verify through automated evaluation - while the setting can be changed through preferences, there's no reliable way to programmatically verify the subtitle rendering configuration without playing a video with subtitles and performing visual analysis.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - verifying subtitle font size/style changes requires visual analysis of rendered subtitles during video playback
No programmatic verification path exists without playing a video with subtitles and performing image analysis of the rendered output
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is semantically appropriate for this type of task that cannot be automatically verified
Metadata accurately explains why automated verification is not possible for subtitle rendering configuration
